card.title: Here We Go Again
card.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're cancelling Sunday again? Mum's already made up the spare bed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Work changed my shift. I can't help it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last time it was overtime. Same empty bed, same explanation from me. You tell her this time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll think I don't want to visit. Could you soften it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the pattern: you cancel, I soften. Now you can arrange the next visit with her too.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 repeated cancellation starts the pattern, A3 repeats overtime and explanation duty and A5 request to soften causes transfer of future planning too.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 changed shift is linked at A3 to prior overtime; B4 softening request supplies A5 the exact recurring division of roles.

relationship.evidence: B2 names a work constraint and B4 fears what Mum will infer from direct cancellation.

heightening.evidence: B4 request reproduces the pattern, letting A5 name it and raise responsibility from one call to the next visit.

specificity.evidence: A1 made spare bed and canceled Sunday establish the family cost and repeated expectation.
